title: Rules for the night inspection station 🚗
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: You have been hired as the night attendant at a vehicle inspection station.

scenes.narration: You have been hired as the night attendant at a vehicle inspection station.
Rule one. Cars arrive between one and four in the morning. Stamp every windscreen with a green sticker, and never look at the driver.
Rule two. If a car arrives with a sticker already on it, dated more than twenty years ago, do not stamp it. Wave it through the exit.
Rule three. The exit gate opens only outward. Nothing drives in through it, however politely it flashes its lights.
Rule four. If you hear the gate chain rattle at 3:00, you are not alone on shift. That is normal. Do not count the cars.
At 3:07 a car rolled in. A green sticker, dated this year. The driver had your face. Rule five, on the wall, was scratched out. But you could still read it.
Never inspect yourself. And the car was already stopping, in the bay marked with your name.
So tell me. Do you follow the rules, or break rule five?
